title: Head of Scale-ups, Developer GTM
description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: SF Bay Area About Cloudflare At Cloudflare, our mission is bold yet simple: to help build a better Internet. Our global network handles trillions of requests each month, protecting and accelerating applications without added hardware, software, or code changes. Our Developer Platform, including Workers, Workers AI, R2, KV, Durable Objects, and Pages, empowers developers to build and deploy applications globally, faster than ever before. About the Team The Developer GTM organization is driving how we attract, inspire, and grow the next generation of builders. We are redefining what developer acquisition looks like in a world where AI and distributed agents are reshaping the stack. Our mission is to lead the transformation of Cloudflare GTM into a Cloud Platform that has roots and capabilities in application services and cybersecurity. We create new pathways for developers to discover Cloudflare, whether through ecosystem partnerships, high-impact content, or creative field engagement and enablement. We are builders, storytellers, and connectors united by one goal: to make Cloudflare the best place for developers to build. The Developer GTM organization partners tightly with Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, RevOps, and Marketing. Developer GTM connects developer activation to durable commercial outcomes: shaping usage into clear proposals, aligning pricing and packaging, enabling the field with repeatable motions, and feeding real-world signals back into Product. About the Role Scale-ups are where developer platform bets become durable at scale. These are companies that have found product-market fit, are growing fast, and are building the platform and infrastructure teams that will define their architecture for years. The choices they make now about where to run workloads, how to serve users globally, and which platforms to build on will compound. Cloudflare needs to be in the room when those decisions are made. We are hiring a Head of Scale-ups to own Cloudflare's Developer Platform GTM strategy for the scale-up segment. This role is the strategic GTM leader who sets the vision for how Cloudflare wins with the fastest-growing technology companies in the world, drives executive engagement with their engineering leadership, and builds the commercial trajectory from early adoption through large-scale committed spend. You will identify the highest-potential accounts, lead the engagement strategy, and work with the field to turn usage into lasting commercial relationships. We are looking for someone who has operated inside or worked closely with high-growth category leaders (e.g. Figma, Notion, Canva, Atlassian, OpenAI, or Anthropic). You understand what it means to scale an engineering organization from Series B/C through enterprise maturity, stand up a platform team, and make infrastructure bets under rapid growth. You bring developer fluency and commercial rigor in equal measure. You can sit with a VP of Engineering and discuss workload architecture in the morning, then work through a multi-year commit structure with Deal Desk in the afternoon. What You Will Do Define and execute the scale-ups GTM strategy. Build the operating model for how Cloudflare acquires, activates, and grows scale-up accounts. Set goals, scorecards, and cadences to prioritize high-potential targets and optimize field resource allocation. Lead executive engagement. Build trusted relationships with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and Heads of Platform at scale-up companies. Run impactful executive business reviews and strategically loop in Cloudflare leadership into the conversation at the right moments. Drive activation, expansion, and commercial structure. Use usage telemetry to map next-best actions, expansion paths, and risks. Work with the account team, Deal Desk, Pricing, Finance, and Legal to design commit structures and consumption-based agreements that match how scale-ups actually build and grow. Identify and prioritize high-potential accounts. Combine usage data, market signals, and ecosystem knowledge to build a target list of scale-ups where Cloudflare's Developer Platform can become deeply embedded. Track their growth trajectories and time engagement to inflection points. Mobilize cross-functional account teams. Align Sales, Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Product on account priorities. Establish clear owners and drive follow-through. Run GTM motions in step
